text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — thinking about adding a "mini smoke" stage for compact/quantized variants during onboarding. short, fast-suite that catches functional mismatches and big perf regressions before we run the full bench.

Kevin Li: +1. What's the target surface? correctness diffs, latency, or both?

Maya Patel: both. primary goals: 1) catch tokenization/kernel incompat (e.g., wrong vocab, bytepair mismatch), 2) KV-cache mapping/shape mismatches, 3) huge logit drift on golden probes, 4) tail-latency cliffs on short seqs. keep it <= 2 min per model.

Amir Khan: for quantized models we should add a tiny golden set (20 prompts) and measure normalized logit distance and top-1 stability. if top-1 flips on >2 prompts => fail.

Olga Jensen: agree. also add a compatibility smoke that runs a single request for each runtime target (xla, cuda, cpu-emu) to catch ABI/ops misses. failure should surface as an ingest-blocker.

Maya Patel: sketch of pass/fail rules I had in mind:
```
mini_smoke: 
  - golden_probes: 20 prompt samples
  - top1_flip_threshold: 2  # >2 flips -> fail
  - avg_logit_l2_threshold: 0.12
  - max_tail_latency_ms: 500
  - runtimes: [cuda, xla, cpu-emu]
  - kv_shape_check: true
  - tokenizer_hash_match: true
```
we can tune numbers but want deterministic quick gate.

Kevin Li: those thresholds seem reasonable as a starting point. question: should mini-smoke be blocking for all models or only for compact variants?

Maya Patel: I propose blocking for compact/quantized variants and advisory for full-precision resaves. compact variants can cause silent quality regressions in prod routes.

Amir Khan: operationally, we also need a fallback routing policy if mini-smoke fails post-deploy. e.g., route traffic to parent fp32 model or a previous passing snapshot. That should be an automated rollback path.

Olga Jensen: +1. And log the exact probe diffs to S3 with a small artifact (diff + seed + output samples) so SREs and model owners can triage.

Maya Patel: good call. BenchBot can upload artifacts and annotate the model record. BenchBot: can you add a step to upload mini-smoke artifacts to model:artifact-bucket when a run fails?

BenchBot: noted. I will create s3://redwood-model-artifacts/mini-smoke/<model_id>/<ts>/ with: 
- probes.jsonl 
- diff_summary.json 
- runtime_env.txt
and post a link in the ingest log.

Kevin Li: one more tradeoff: speed vs coverage. if the mini-smoke is too weak we flood the full bench; if too strict we block useful compact builds. propose a probation tier: first failure for a new variant is advisory (notify owner + auto-schedule full bench), second consecutive failure blocks. keeps noise down.

Maya Patel: I like the probation idea. we should persist a short failure history for variant ids. also add an override label for platform-team-approved experiments.

Amir Khan: implementation note: mini-smoke should run in a small ephemeral pod with our runtime shim and use the same quant library as the serving runtime to avoid false negatives. also seed RNG and detokenize with the same tokenizer version.

Olga Jensen: ops concern: add a circuit-breaker so if lots of mini-smokes start failing due to infra (kernel rollout) we can flip to 'degraded' mode and make mini-smoke advisory cluster-wide.

Maya Patel: summary actions:
- add mini-smoke job in onboarding pipeline (blocking for compact variants)
- config snippet stored in model manifest with thresholds
- probation policy: 1 advisory then block on repeat
- BenchBot artifact upload on fail
- fallback routing to parent snapshot on automated failure post-deploy
- cluster-level degraded toggle for infra incidents

Kevin Li: I'll pick up the pipeline wiring (k8s job + manifest hook). Amir can own the runtime shim alignment tests. Olga can add the degraded toggle and artifact retention policy. Maya will draft the RFC update with thresholds and probation flow.

Amir Khan: ack. i'll prototype the random-seed deterministic harness and a small set of golden probes (will share).

Olga Jensen: ack, will add a short runbook for triage and signal owners.

Maya Patel: thanks all — will open a follow-up RFC PR with config examples and the probation state machine. ping me on thread if you want to flag anything. :thumbsup:
